facts.text: gym_aloha/AlohaInsertion-v0 is registered with entry_point gym_aloha.env:AlohaEnv, max_episode_steps 300 and kwargs obs_type pixels and task insertion
The registered environment is nondeterministic: the registration says so because even seeded rendered observations are slightly different
For a task other than pick_and_place the action space is Box(low=-1, high=1, shape=(len(ACTIONS),), dtype=float32)
ACTIONS has 14 entries: six arm targets and a normalized gripper position per arm, with the gripper 0 close and 1 open
pick_and_place uses the seven SINGLE_ARM_ACTIONS instead of the bimanual ACTIONS
With obs_type pixels the observation space is a Dict with one top Box of shape (observation_height, observation_width, 3), values 0 to 255 and dtype uint8
The default observation_width is 640 and observation_height is 480
The pixels observation keeps only the top camera frame from the raw observation
The simulation control timestep is DT = 0.02 seconds (50 Hz)
The insertion task loads gym_aloha/assets/bimanual_viperx_insertion.xml and the InsertionTask
A reset with a seed seeds the task RNG and samples the insertion peg and socket poses from that seed
The insertion reset samples the peg x uniformly from 0.1 to 0.2 and the socket x from -0.2 to -0.1, both y from 0.4 to 0.6 at z 0.05
The insertion reward is 0, 1, 2 or 3 on the way and 4 when the pin is touched; the pin-touch check is the successful insertion
step returns the observation, reward, terminated, truncated and info; terminated is reward == 4, info is_success is the same test, and AlohaEnv itself always returns truncated False
render returns the top camera image from the MuJoCo physics

determinism.notes: reset(seed) seeds the task RNG and the insertion pose sampler, but the upstream registration sets nondeterministic=True because seeded rendered observations are slightly different (gym_aloha/__init__.py:7-9).  This package's fake repeats a trajectory for a seed; that is not a bit-exact replay claim about the upstream MuJoCo renderer.

gaps: the upstream is a MuJoCo/dm_control rigid-body model of two ViperX arms, a peg, a socket and a table; this package's fake is kinematic and models none of the contacts, friction, actuator dynamics or gravity, so it is an F0 stand-in for the F1 upstream model
the fake returns a 4 x 4 x 3 uint8 stand-in for the environment's 480 x 640 x 3 top camera RGB frame (env.py:56-66) to keep receipts small; it does not render MuJoCo
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
the fake's reset draws from Python's random.Random while upstream uses numpy RandomState and MuJoCo physics, so one seed does not give the same trajectory on the two
the fake's success rule is a placeholder action threshold, not the upstream contact test between the red peg, the pin and the grippers (tasks/sim.py:177-222)
snapshot and restore are not offered: AlohaEnv defines set_state but no get_state (env.py:252), so the bridge cannot offer the pair
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
